name: Permanent Residence by Marriage or Common-Law Union

qualifying_event.description: For the foreign spouse or common-law partner of an Ecuadorian citizen, or of a foreign national holding indefinite/permanent residence in Ecuador. Grants permanent residence directly -- no prior temporary residence period is required.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate from the Civil Registry (or registration in Ecuador of a foreign marriage); common-law union registration with the Civil Registry; proof of lawful means of subsistence; interview with the Zonal Directorate or consular office.

requirements.blocker_text: Marriage certificate from the Civil Registry (registered in Ecuador if the marriage occurred abroad), or common-law union (unión de hecho) registered with the Civil Registry.
Must demonstrate lawful means of subsistence per Ministerial Agreement No. 70 (28 June 2024).

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or registered common-law union
Proof of lawful means of subsistence

sources.title: gob.ec (MREMH official portal) -- Permanent residence by marriage or common-law union: no minimum cohabitation/waiting period stated, grants Permanent Residence Visa directly (not a temporary/provisional step), online e-VISAS application, fee discounts for seniors and persons with disabilities

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ecuador). Notably, this route grants PERMANENT residence directly with no minimum relationship-duration or prior-temporary-residence requirement stated on the tier-1 source -- a materially faster structure than most other countries in this dataset, where marriage typically grants a temporary/provisional status first or only reduces (not eliminates) a residence-based naturalisation clock. No separate 'citizenship by marriage' fast-track exists in Ecuadorian naturalisation law per the source reviewed for ec_naturalisation.json -- marriage's advantage here is entirely at the RESIDENCE stage, not the citizenship stage.
